offline.text: The journal works only online: grades and the schedule are not kept on the device.

offline.notSentGrade: The grade has not reached the server yet: it can only be removed.

calendar.title: Schedule in your calendar
calendar.hint: A personal link adds your lessons to Google Calendar, iPhone Calendar or Outlook. Cancellations and moves appear there by themselves, usually within a few hours.
calendar.hintTeacher: A personal link adds your lessons, assisted lessons and substitutions to Google Calendar, iPhone Calendar or Outlook. Cancellations and moves appear there by themselves, usually within a few hours.
calendar.how: Google Calendar: «Other calendars» → «+» → «From URL». iPhone: «Settings» → «Calendar» → «Accounts» → «Add Account» → «Add Subscribed Calendar».
calendar.secret: The link is like a password to your schedule: do not publish it. If strangers got it, reissue it.
calendar.reissueText: The old link stops working at once: calendars subscribed to it must subscribe again.

payments.title: Payments
payments.discountHint: Applies to the next charges; existing ones do not change.
payments.billingHint: Each student is charged for every priced group they were in for at least one day of the month: the group's fee minus their discount. Pressing again doubles nothing.
payments.feesHint: Empty or 0 — the group is free. A new fee applies from the next charge.
payments.author: Entered by
payments.voidText: The record stays in the history crossed out and no longer counts towards the debt.
payments.myHint: Payments are accepted by the center's administrator. If something here is wrong, contact them.
